name: AlphaGuard
description: A research agent that stops you from being fooled by a beautiful backtest. It exposes deterministic, auditable investment-research and risk-gate actions to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol (WebMCP).

policy.title: No auto-execution. Agents plan, deterministic rules veto, humans approve.
policy.llm_authority: PLAN_ONLY — the LLM may plan the research sequence but cannot modify risk rules, cannot override a gate, and cannot create an order intent.
policy.human_oversight: AlphaGuard never places orders automatically. Paper-only by default; external brokers are disabled. Any would-be execution requires explicit human approval that lives outside the agent's reach.
policy.evidence_before_action: Every tool output carries structured evidence and a data fingerprint; nothing is asserted without it.
policy.not_investment_advice: Research/procedural demo only. Makes no return promises and does not represent real returns.

tools.name: audit_strategy
tools.summary: Run the full guarded audit of a strategy proposal.
tools.description: Takes a research task in natural language, plans the tool sequence with the LLM, runs a deterministic backtest on marked synthetic data, then applies data-provenance, data-quality, walk-forward and production-readiness gates. Returns a verdict and a full auditable tool trace. The LLM has planning authority only and can never override a gate or create an order intent.

task.description: The research/validation task, described in natural language (min 8 chars, max 500).

output.description: Structured verdict (ELIGIBLE|BLOCKED), headline, summary, planner metadata, and an ordered trace of the executed tools with evidence.

tools.name: run_demo_backtest
tools.summary: Run a reproducible backtest on marked synthetic data.
tools.description: Returns a deterministic, reproducible backtest with baselines and out-of-sample metrics. The dataset is explicitly marked SYNTHETIC_DEMO and is not production evidence.

output.description: Full backtest result including metrics, out-of-sample metrics, baselines and dataset provenance.

tools.name: validate_dataset
tools.summary: Validate an OHLCV CSV against a dataset contract.
tools.description: Validates OHLCV CSV text against required columns and data-quality rules, returning errors, warnings and a unique data fingerprint. Use before trusting any market data.

output.description: Validation report with errors, warnings and data fingerprint.

tools.name: market_rules
tools.summary: Read US / CN market trading rules.
tools.description: Returns trading-unit, short-selling and price-limit rules for US or CN markets. Look these up before proposing an order quantity or side.

output.description: Market rule descriptions keyed by market.

tools.name: run_experiment
tools.summary: Validate a user CSV and replay the fixed, research-only experiment protocol.
tools.description: Validates a user-provided OHLCV CSV then replays the fixed experiment protocol with the same guardrails. Never creates an order intent.

output.description: Experiment replay result with evidence and guardrails.
